name: Table Row Links
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Cleanup keeps anchors that a bare row URI before punctuation or an HTML row link references.
Row labels no longer split an emoji at the 40 character limit.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Pro cleanup no longer removes an anchor whose row link is followed by punctuation or sits in an HTML link.
A row label no longer cuts an emoji in half at 40 characters.
tip: Run Jump to table row... and type part of a label to move the cursor to a marked row in this note.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Table Row Links is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for trusting it with your tables.
